subject: Television & Streaming
title: Television in Times of Crisis
description: A micro-lesson that makes Television in Times of Crisis usable.

hook.text: During the COVID-19 lockdown, global television viewership surged by 60 percent.

buildup.text: Tiger King, a bizarre docuseries about big cat owners, became a shared cultural moment during the pandemic's darkest.

discovery.text: Streaming replaced social life. Watch parties, live-tweeting, and shared viewing became substitutes for human gathering.

twist.text: The pandemic proved television's oldest function is still its most important: bringing people together, when they're.

climax.text: Crisis reveals what a medium is truly for.

punchline.text: When the world stopped, television held it together.

quiz.question: How did television viewing change during the COVID-19 pandemic?
options: Global viewership surged by 60 percent as people sought connection during isolation
